name: .224 Cal-33gr Stone Hammer®
note: Recommended use: Small to medium game hunting, up to deer size game. The product page also says: "This little 33gr Stone Hammer™ simply hits very hard at the velocities that is capable of. When we impact tested this bullet it was quite impressive how well it worked at high and low velocity. This bullet will push 3000 fps in the little 22 Hornet and push close to 5000 fps in the big 22 calibers."
